lines.en: label kirinspecial40:
scene nightsky
The stars are shining, the air is cool, and I’m on my way to a distant convenience store to bother a girl who is more than likely thinking about having sex with me right now.
lines.zh: 繁星闪烁，空气微凉，而我正前往一家远处的便利店，去打扰一个此刻多半正在想着要和我上床的女孩。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome1
There must be some sort of special tonight, though, as I get two for the price of one the moment I arrive.
lines.zh: 不过今晚大概有什么特别活动吧，因为我一到就买一送一了。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, are you two ever {i}not{/i} together?
lines.zh: : 只是出于好奇，你们俩有{i}不{/i}在一起的时候吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Kirin follows me around a lot.
lines.zh: : 基本没有。Kirin 老是跟着我。

lines.en: : She’s kind of like a horny puppy who keeps trying to hump my leg.
lines.zh: : 她有点像一只发情的小狗，总想着往我腿上蹭。

lines.en: : I have no other options when she won’t let me hump her face.
lines.zh: : 她又不肯让我往她脸上蹭，我别无选择。

lines.en: : Keep at it, Kirin. You’ll get your wish one day.
lines.zh: : 继续努力，Kirin。总有一天你会如愿的。

lines.en: : He says, not realizing it is {i}he{/i} who prevents my wishes from coming true in the first place.
lines.zh: : 他说得倒轻巧，没意识到{i}他{/i}才是一开始就让我的愿望落空的人。

lines.en: : Are you here to see me, Sensei? Or are you just passing by on your way to hang out with Tsuneyo again? Answer honestly. I promise I won’t get jealous when you tell me it's the latter.
lines.zh: : 你是来找我的吗，老师？还是你只是路过，又要去找 Tsuneyo 玩？老实回答。就算你说是后者，我也保证不吃醋。

lines.en: : I’m actually here for Kirin. I installed a GPS tracking device on her phone when she wasn’t looking and I can now pinpoint where she is at all times.
lines.zh: : 我其实是来找 Kirin 的。我趁她不注意在她手机里装了 GPS 追踪器，现在随时都能定位她在哪儿。

lines.en: : I know that’s supposed to creep me out, but I kind of like it.
lines.zh: : 我知道这话本该让我毛骨悚然，但我还挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : You’d have to figure out the passcode to her phone before you could do that, wouldn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你要这么做，总得先破解她手机的密码吧？

lines.en: : Is it 6969?
scene kirinwalkhome2
: Aww. It’s always so cute when you unintentionally remind me of how close we are.
lines.zh: : 哇。你总是无意间提醒我我们有多亲密，真是可爱。

lines.en: : Hey! We have the same passcode! Now we can spy on one another and go through each other’s camera rolls!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我们密码一样！那我们就可以互相监视、翻彼此的相册了！

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome3
: Wow, good idea! I definitely haven’t already gone into your phone and sent myself copies of the nudes you sent Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哇，好主意！我绝对还没事先翻过你手机、把你发给老师的裸照转发给我自己！

lines.en: if kirinlust20 == True:
: I saw one of yours too, but I don’t know if it was for him or your sister. You have really nice nipples.
lines.zh: : 我也看到你的一张，不过不知道是发给他的还是发给你的姐姐。你乳头真好看。

lines.en: : Thank you, Noriko! It was for Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Noriko！是发给老师的。

lines.en: : Can you please not throw me under the bus every chance you get? It’s starting to wear me down.
lines.zh: : 你能不能别一有机会就把我卖了？我快被你磨垮了。

lines.en: else:
: I didn’t find any in your phone. I was actually really surprised. Tons of porn, though. I didn’t realize you had such a thing for twins.
lines.zh: : 你手机里一张都没找到。我还真挺意外的。色情片倒是一大堆。我不知道你原来好双胞胎这一口。

lines.en: : It’s kind of sad how I can pinpoint exactly when you must have looked at my phone by the porn you found.
lines.zh: : 我能根据你找到的片子精准推断出你是什么时候偷看我手机的，这也挺可悲的。

lines.en: : A little, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有一点吧。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome4
: Anyway, assuming the GPS tracker thing is true, which I kind of hope it is...are you {i}actually{/i} here to see me?
lines.zh: : 总之，假设 GPS 追踪器这事是真的——我还挺希望它是真的——你{i}真的{/i}是来找我的吗？

lines.en: : No. I’m here for Noriko. How would I have even known you were here?
lines.zh: : 不是。我是来找 Noriko 的。不然我怎么可能知道你在这儿？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome5
: Ugh, that was such an easy opportunity for you to earn points with me and you completely squandered it.
lines.zh: : 啧，这么容易就能在我这儿加分的机会，你居然全浪费了。

lines.en: : It earned plenty of points with me!
lines.zh: : 在我这儿可是加了不少分！

lines.en: : Cool, but what the fuck is he going to do with them when you’d already do literally anything he asks?
lines.zh: : 酷，可既然你早就会照他说的做任何事，他拿这些分还能他妈的干嘛？

lines.en: : Would you not? Because I’m pretty sure you were in that same boat before I even met Noriko.
lines.zh: : 你难道不是吗？我敢说在我认识 Noriko 之前，你也是同样的处境。

lines.en: : {i}Re-{/i}met Noriko. Don’t forget the years and years I spent secretly being in love with you.
lines.zh: : 是{i}重{/i}逢 Noriko。别忘了，我偷偷爱了你那么多年。

lines.en: : There’s a clear difference there, Sensei. I would do anything you ask me to do because I am a horrible, deviant person. {i}Noriko{/i} would do anything you ask because she is your pet.
lines.zh: : 这可不一样，老师。我愿意做你要求的任何事，因为我是个糟糕的变态。而{i}Noriko{/i}愿意做你要求的任何事，因为她是你的宠物。

lines.en: : That’s what the collar’s for, you know. There’s a slot on the back you can attach a leash to. I keep the one that came with it in my underwear drawer.
lines.zh: : 项圈就是干这个用的啊。背后有个插槽可以挂牵引绳。配套的那条我收在内衣抽屉里。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome6
: Oh, is {i}that{/i} what that was? I thought it was a belt.
lines.zh: : 哦，{i}那{/i}玩意儿是项圈？我还以为是腰带。

lines.en: : Stop taking my panties, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 别再偷我的内裤了，Kirin。

lines.en: : Why? I always put them back.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我又不是不还回去。

lines.en: : Ignoring the fact that Noriko might actually be a dog and the equally unsurprising fact that Kirin will do anything to get herself off, it’s nice seeing you two so {i}together{/i} all the time.
lines.zh: : 先不管 Noriko 可能真的是条狗，以及 Kirin 会为了爽什么事都做得出来这个同样不意外的事实——看你们俩这么{i}形影不离{/i}还挺好的。

lines.en: : Most people would think that two roommates would struggle balancing a shared sexual connection with one guy without their feelings starting to get in the way.
lines.zh: : 大多数人会觉得，两个室友共享同一个男人的性关系，很难不把感情掺和进去。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome7
: Maybe. But I don’t have feelings for you. That’s Noriko’s thing. I’m the cool sex friend you secretly invite on business trips and bone on the side.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但我对你没感觉。那是 Noriko 的事。我是你偷偷带去出差、在旁边偷腥的酷炮友。

lines.en: : Also, even with you and me teetering off the precipice of finally making our genitals touch, as well as my infallible desire to have my first time with you be private-
lines.zh: : 再说，就算我和你已经在“生殖器终于碰在一起”的悬崖边上摇摇欲坠，而且我又铁了心要让我的第一次私下进行——

lines.en: : With a special exception made for her best friend.
lines.zh: : 还得为她最好的朋友破个例。

lines.en: : No. But, as I was saying, even with that we’re probably, like...the second or third dorm room closest to having casual threesomes with you!
lines.zh: : 不。但就像我说的，即便如此，我们大概……算是第二或第三接近能跟你随便玩三人行的寝室了！

lines.en: : Is this like Uta’s “Sensei love journal” thing? Are you two ranking the sexual stuff while Uta ranks how much I care about everyone?
lines.zh: : 这跟 Uta 的“老师爱心日记”是一回事吗？你们俩给性爱部分排名，Uta 给我对每个人的在乎程度排名？

lines.en: : What else are we supposed to do in class? You don’t make us work.
lines.zh: : 不然上课还能干嘛？你又不让我们写作业。

lines.en: : There’s some disagreement on who we have for first place, though. My money’s on Dorm 7. In fact, I’d be really surprised if Uta & Io aren’t already screwing around together.
lines.zh: : 不过第一名是谁有点分歧。我押 7 号寝室。说实话，要是 Uta 和 Io 还没搞在一起，我会很惊讶。

lines.en: : And what-
: Makoto and Miku and it’s not even close.
lines.zh: : Makoto 和 Miku，根本没有可比性。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome8
: But they’re the only dorm room that’s completely straight. I’ve confirmed at least one bisexual member of every other room.
lines.zh: : 可她们是唯一一间全直的寝室。其他每一间我都至少确认过有一个双性恋。

lines.en: : What? How?
lines.zh: : 什么？怎么做到的？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome9
: I asked.
lines.zh: : 我问的啊。

lines.en: : Damn. If only Rin had that idea.
lines.zh: : 靠。要是 Rin 有这脑子就好了。

lines.en: : Dorm 2 and Dorm 9 have both {i}technically{/i} not admitted to anything indicating a break in pure heterosexuality thus far, but that is subject to change based on progression throughout the year.
lines.zh: : 2 号寝室和 9 号寝室{i}严格来说{/i}到目前为止都还没承认过任何打破纯异性恋的事，但这一结论会随着这一年的推进而改变。

lines.en: : I remain steadfast in my predictions of both Sana’s lesbian awakening as well as Yasu’s pansexual one.
lines.zh: : 我依然坚持我的预言：Sana 会觉醒成同性恋，Yasu 会觉醒成泛性恋。

lines.en: : It’s really surprising just how much a room can accomplish when both of the girls in it were born without filters.
lines.zh: : 一间寝室里的两个女生都生来没有过滤器，能达成的事还真让人吃惊。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome10
: It also helps that pretty much everyone likes me and doesn’t mind telling me stuff.
lines.zh: : 而且基本上所有人都喜欢我、不介意跟我说些事，这也帮了忙。

lines.en: : I don’t have any exceptional social abilities like Noriko does, but I’m pretty sure my drive and thirst for sexual knowledge help in some way too.
lines.zh: : 我没有 Noriko 那种出众的社交能力，但我觉得我对性知识的干劲和渴求大概也有点用。

lines.en: : Not like I’m complaining, but do you two ever talk about anything that {i}isn’t{/i} sexual?
lines.zh: : 我不是在抱怨啦，但你们俩到底有没有聊过{i}不{/i}跟性有关的东西？

lines.en: : We go to the movies sometimes?
lines.zh: : 我们偶尔会去看电影？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome11
: Oh, speaking of which, I should probably start heading back. I have to stop at home to watch some stupid fucking video with my parents.
lines.zh: : 哦，说到这个，我大概该回去了。我得回家陪我爸妈看那个蠢得要死的视频。

lines.en: : It’s not one of those “Pray the gay away” things, is it? Because I watched some documentary last night about homosexuality in Japan and what some of those parents do is fucking wild.

lines.zh: : 天啊，我{i}倒希望{/i}是。至少那个听起来还挺有意思。我们要看他们那蠢得要死的婚礼录像。他们每年都把它搞成一个大活动，全家人都得坐在一起看。

lines.en: : Everybody always fucking cries and talks about how cute it is and blah, blah, blah. Weddings are stupid. I’m never getting married. It looks exhausting.
lines.zh: : 所有人都会他妈的哭，说多可爱多可爱，吧啦吧啦吧啦。婚礼真蠢。我永远不结婚。看着就累。

lines.en: if kirinmarry == True:
: Really? Even after I chose you in that fuck, marry, kill game?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？就算我在那个“操、娶、杀”的游戏里选了你也一样？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome13
: Wh...Why do you even remember that?! That was so long ago! And was literally just {i}a game!{/i} There’s no way we’re ever actually getting married!
lines.zh: : 你……你怎么还记得那个？！那都多久以前的事了！而且{i}就只是个游戏{/i}！我们怎么可能真的结婚！

lines.en: : Can you seriously picture {i}me{/i} gathering kids up and making hot chocolate while we all sit around and pull from the same box of tissues?!
lines.zh: : 你真能想象{i}我{/i}把孩子们聚起来煮热可可，大家围坐在一起从同一盒纸巾里抽纸的画面吗？！

lines.en: : I imagine that same scene every night...It’s the last thing I think of before going to sleep.
lines.zh: : 我每天晚上都想象那个画面……那是我入睡前最后想的事。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome14
: S...Shut up! No it’s not!
lines.zh: : 闭……闭嘴！才不是！

lines.en: : Uhh...well ignoring Kirin’s thoughts on marriage, why don’t you take this chance to walk her home?
lines.zh: : 呃……算了，先不管 Kirin 对婚姻的看法，你何不趁这个机会送她回家？

lines.en: else:
: Never?

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome15
: Do {i}you{/i} want to get married?
lines.zh: : 你{i}自己{/i}想结婚吗？

lines.en: : No...but you’re not me. You’re in high school.
lines.zh: : 不想……但你不是我。你还在上高中。

lines.en: : For all we know, this whole rebellious thing of yours could end any day now and you could turn into another Karin but...with smaller boobs and more sexual experience.
lines.zh: : 说不定你这套叛逆随时都会结束，你会变成另一个 Karin，只不过……胸更小、性经验更多。

lines.en: : That’s the single dumbest thing you’ve ever said.
lines.zh: : 这是你说过的最蠢的一句话。

lines.en: : Ignoring Kirin’s thoughts on marriage, why don’t you take this chance to walk her home?
lines.zh: : 先不管 Kirin 对婚姻的看法，你何不趁这个机会送她回家？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome16
: Hm? Why? I can walk myself home. I do it all the time.
lines.zh: : 嗯？为什么？我自己能回家。我一直都是自己回去的。

lines.en: : Are you sure? You don’t want to, you know, use this time to {i}be alone?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？你不想，那个……趁这个时间{i}独处一下？{/i}

lines.en: : I’ve gotta do inventory tonight. I’ve been slacking off way too much lately and having you around will just make me slack off even more.
lines.zh: : 我今晚得盘货。我最近摸鱼摸太多了，你在这儿我只会摸得更厉害。

lines.en: : I mean...okay. If it’s fine with Kirin, I can walk her home.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……好吧。如果 Kirin 没意见，我可以送她回家。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome17
: It’s fine with me. All the homeless people around here creep the fuck out of me anyway. But if you try to hold my hand, I’m going to make you walk five steps behind me.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。这一带的流浪汉反正也把我吓得要死。不过你要是敢牵我的手，我就让你走在我后面五步远。

lines.en: : When have I literally ever tried to do that before?
lines.zh: : 我以前到底什么时候试过那么做？

lines.en: : When have you ever been nice enough to walk me home before? I normally just blow you and leave.
lines.zh: : 你以前又什么时候好心到送我回家过？我一般都是给你口完就走。

lines.en: : In my defense, this was Noriko’s idea.
lines.zh: : 替我说句公道话，这是 Noriko 的主意。

lines.en: : Yeah. Sorry for forcing you two who definitely don’t like one another together. I’ll think harder about my choices next time.
lines.zh: : 是嘛。抱歉把你们两个明明互相看不顺眼的人硬凑到一起。下次我会好好想清楚。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome18
: What are you talking about? Of course I like Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我当然喜欢老师。

lines.en: : I just happen to like his penis more.
lines.zh: : 我只是更喜欢他的鸡巴而已。

lines.zh: : 这也合理。毕竟那是我最大的优点。

lines.en: : Call me when you get home? I can put you on speaker while I count boxes of Twinkies.
lines.zh: : 你到家了给我打个电话？我可以开免提，边数 Twinkies 的箱子。

lines.en: : And this is exactly why I don’t date. You two are gross.
lines.zh: : 这就是我不谈恋爱的原因。你们俩真恶心。

lines.en: scene black
Kirin and I exit the convenience store together and take off in the direction of her parents’ house.
lines.zh: Kirin 和我一起走出便利店，朝她父母家走去。

lines.en: The homeless are out in full force tonight.
lines.zh: 今晚流浪汉全员出动。

lines.en: Thankfully, “full force” for them just means leaning up against chain-link fences and staring at us as we move through the streets.
lines.zh: 所幸他们的“全员出动”不过是靠在铁丝网上，盯着我们穿过街道。

lines.en: There’s one person in particular, an old woman with grayed-out hair and several missing teeth, who opens her mouth and shouts something incoherent at us.
lines.zh: 其中有一个人特别显眼——一个头发灰白、缺了好几颗牙的老太婆——她张开嘴，冲我们喊了些含混不清的话。

lines.en: Kirin jumps.
lines.zh: Kirin 吓了一跳。

lines.en: It’s the first time I’ve ever heard any of them speak, if you could even call that indiscernible cry “speaking.”
lines.zh: 我还是头一次听到他们当中有人开口，如果那声分辨不出的嚎叫也能算“说话”的话。

lines.en: And so I misinterpret it as a desperate plea for help and lose myself for a moment, turning back toward her to stare once more.
lines.zh: 于是我把它误解成绝望的求救，一时失神，转身又朝她看了一眼。

lines.en: She yanks out one of her few remaining teeth and throws it at me.
lines.zh: 她拔下自己仅剩的几颗牙中的一颗，朝我扔了过来。

lines.en: It lands at my feet, covered in blood and what I assume is gum-residue.
lines.zh: 它落在我脚边，沾着血，还有我猜是牙龈残留物的东西。

lines.en: Kirin never notices.
lines.zh: Kirin 始终没有察觉。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome19
But then we make it to a riverbank and things begin again.
lines.zh: 但后来我们走到一处河岸，一切又重新开始了。

lines.en: The silence and unease disintegrates, leaving nothing but the two of us and a fading crooked skyline comprised of abandoned apartment buildings, decorating the murky water with reflections of the past.
lines.zh: 沉默与不安消散殆尽，只剩下我们两个人，以及一片由废弃公寓楼构成的、正在褪色的歪斜天际线，把过去的倒影涂抹在浑浊的水面上。

lines.en: Within them, if I focus hard enough, I can see into the windows.
lines.zh: 只要我足够专注，就能透过它们看见窗户里面。

lines.en: And in those rooms, now devoid of everything, were people.
lines.zh: 而那些如今空无一物的房间里，曾经有人。

lines.en: Some were eating, some were dancing-
lines.zh: 有的在吃饭，有的在跳舞——

lines.en: But all of them were blind.
lines.zh: 但他们全都是盲人。

lines.en: I could tell by the lack of irises.
lines.zh: 我是从没有虹膜看出来的。

lines.en: : So, was I right?
lines.zh: : 那么，我说对了吗？

lines.en: : Right about what?
lines.zh: : 对什么？

lines.en: : Makoto & Miku, obviously. Have you three taken the plunge yet? What’s Makoto like in bed?
lines.zh: : 当然是 Makoto 和 Miku。你们三个已经跨出那一步了吗？Makoto 在床上怎么样？

lines.en: : Is this really what we’re going to talk about?
lines.zh: : 我们真的要聊这个吗？

lines.en: : If we talk about anything else, we might accidentally enjoy ourselves.
lines.zh: : 要是聊别的，我们可能会不小心玩得很开心。

lines.en: : And that would be bad...why?
lines.zh: : 那有什么不好……吗？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome20
: Well, it wouldn’t be right to steal Noriko’s thunder right when you two are...how did she word it again? “On the precipice of making your genitals touch?”
lines.zh: : 嗯，在你和 Noriko 正……她是怎么说的来着？“在让你们的生殖器碰在一起的悬崖边上”的时候，抢她的风头不太好吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I have no idea why she put it that way.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也不知道她为什么要那么说。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome21
: Because she’s nervous. I’m pretty sure her heart hasn’t stopped palpitating ever since she dry-humped you on the beach.
lines.zh: : 因为她紧张。自从她在沙滩上隔着衣服蹭你之后，我敢说她的心就没停止过狂跳。

lines.en: : Which reminds me, I’m mad at you.
lines.zh: : 说起这个，我在生你的气。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : A few reasons.
lines.zh: : 有几个原因。

lines.en: : Not only did you totally butcher Noriko’s big moment by bailing on her to go see someone else, but you neglected to tell me that you made it to third base with Miku.
lines.zh: : 你不仅丢下 Noriko 跑去见别人，把她的重要时刻搞砸了，还没告诉我你已经跟 Miku 上了三垒。

lines.en: : Oh yeah. Surprise.
lines.zh: : 哦对。惊喜吧。

lines.en: : Yeah. {i}Surprise.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊。{i}惊喜。{/i}

lines.en: if kirinlust30 == True:
: You toyed with me on purpose when I brought her to your hotel room.
lines.zh: : 我把她带到你酒店房间那次，你是故意耍我的。

lines.en: : You {i}knew{/i} that I wouldn’t feel bad if I’d known you two had already started messing around.
lines.zh: : 你{i}明知{/i}我要是早知道你们俩已经开始乱搞，就不会觉得难受了。

lines.en: : So you took advantage of me and made me feel like shit. I won’t forget that.
lines.zh: : 所以你利用了我，还让我觉得自己很烂。我不会忘记的。

lines.en: : Well, excuse me for exposing your humanity. I didn’t realize you were so opposed to it.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，抱歉戳穿了你的人性。我不知道你这么抗拒这个。

lines.en: : No, I think you’re misunderstanding something. Yes, I’m mad. And yes, that is in large part to you taking advantage of me, but it’s not like there was no...unexpected benefit that came from it.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得你误会了什么。是的，我在生气。是的，很大程度是因为你利用了我，但也不是说……就没有什么意外的收获。

lines.en: : Like?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome22
: Well, for one, I think I might have a humiliation kink now.
lines.zh: : 首先，我觉得我可能有了羞辱癖。

lines.en: : But the more impactful part is that all of those things you said made me feel...different.
lines.zh: : 但影响更大的是，你说的那些话让我感觉……不一样了。

lines.en: : It’s not often I feel genuinely bad about the things that I do. But Miku has always been a thing in my life that I’ve truly wanted to protect.
lines.zh: : 我很少真的为自己做过的事感到愧疚。但 Miku 一直是我生命里真正想保护的东西。

lines.en: : You mean when you're {i}not{/i} taking advantage of her for being high, right?
lines.zh: : 你是说在你{i}没有{/i}利用她嗨了的时候，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly.
lines.zh: : 对，正是。

lines.en: : There’s a lot of stuff I “almost” go through with. And that night, I was probably hoping she would have talked me out of it.
lines.zh: : 有很多事我都是“差一点”就做了。那天晚上，我大概还希望她能劝住我。

lines.en: : You see, when things become too real, I normally still have an {i}out.{/i} And once she agreed, my choices were to either admit that I’m weak or just go along with it.
lines.zh: : 你看，事情变得太真实的时候，我通常还有个{i}退路{/i}。可她一答应，我就只剩两个选择：要么承认自己软弱，要么就这么顺着来。

lines.en: : As you saw, I went along with it.
lines.zh: : 如你所见，我选了顺着来。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome21
: You made me pay for that. And, while I’m mad, I appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 你让我为此付出了代价。虽然我在生气，但我很感激。

lines.en: : I didn’t think you had it in you.
lines.zh: : 我没想到你做得出来。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome23
: But, then again, I didn’t think Miku had it in {i}her{/i} to let a grown man finger her and here we are.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我也没想到 Miku {i}愿意{/i}让一个成年男人用手指弄她，可我们现在就在这儿聊这个。

lines.en: : Maybe I’m less special than I thought?
lines.zh: : 也许我没自己想的那么特别？

lines.en: : Well, the Noriko thing I can understand. I feel bad about that as well. But I fully intend to make up for it soon.
lines.zh: : Noriko 那件事我能理解。我也为此内疚。但我打算很快就补偿她。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome24
: Don’t fuck her just to “make up for it.” She’s not me. She won’t be able to separate sex from the more mushy, emotional parts of it.
lines.zh: : 别为了“补偿”去睡她。她不是我。她没法把性和那些黏糊糊的感情部分分开。

lines.en: : That’s not-
lines.zh: : 那不是——

lines.en: : Just say “okay.” I don’t want to get any more involved in your Romeo & Juliet bullshit than I already am.
lines.zh: : 说一句“好吧”就行。我不想再比现在更深地卷进你那套罗密欧与朱丽叶的破事了。

lines.en: : Can I comment on the Miku thing, at least?
lines.zh: : 至少让我评论一下 Miku 那件事，行吗？

lines.en: : Yes, because that I {i}do{/i} want to get more involved in.
lines.zh: : 行，因为那件事我{i}确实{/i}想多掺和一点。

lines.en: : Were you keeping it a secret on purpose? Or did you just not think it was important enough to tell me about it?
lines.zh: : 你是故意瞒着我，还是觉得这事不重要，不值得告诉我？

lines.en: : Honestly? I didn’t think about it at all.
lines.zh: : 老实说？我压根没想过。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome25
: I appreciate your “drive and thirst for sexual knowledge” or whatever, but that doesn’t mean I’m going to hand-deliver all of my new sexual encounters to you so you can rate and review them.
lines.zh: : 我很欣赏你的“对性知识的干劲和渴求”之类的，但那不意味着我要把我所有的新艳遇打包送到你手上，让你评分写测评。

lines.en: : Not even the ones with people who are important to me?
lines.zh: : 就算是跟对我很重要的人也不行？

lines.en: : You’ve proven there’s no issue getting that information from those people directly, so I don’t really see what {i}me{/i} being the one to tell you instead of them accomplishes.
lines.zh: : 你已经证明了，从那些人本人那儿拿到情报一点问题都没有，所以我不觉得由{i}我{/i}来告诉你、而不是由她们，能有什么意义。

lines.en: : You don’t?
lines.zh: : 你真不觉得？

lines.en: : No, I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 不，真不觉得。

lines.en: : You {i}really{/i} don’t understand why I’m mad about you keeping the Miku thing a secret from me?
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}不明白我为什么因为你瞒着 Miku 的事生你的气？

lines.en: : It’s not because you still like her, is it? I thought you got over that a while ago?
lines.zh: : 该不会是因为你还喜欢她吧？我以为你早就放下了？

lines.en: : I love Miku, but I don’t {i}like{/i} her. Like, don’t get me wrong, I would do {i}heinous{/i} things to that little tomboy if given the opportunity, but that’s not why I’m upset.
lines.zh: : 我爱 Miku，但我不{i}喜欢{/i}她。别误会，要是有机会，我愿意对那个假小子做{i}丧心病狂{/i}的事，但我不是因为这个生气。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : Because it’s {i}both{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 因为那是{i}你们两个{/i}。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome26
: Listen, I am {i}not{/i} the kind of girl who’s going to go on some long-winded rant about what you mean to me or my {i}feelings{/i} or any of that stuff because-
lines.zh: : 听着，我{i}不是{/i}那种会长篇大论地讲你对我意味着什么、讲我的{i}感受{/i}或诸如此类的女生，因为——

lines.en: : Well, frankly, all of that makes me {i}way{/i} more uncomfortable than anything involving sex ever will.
lines.zh: : 说实话，那些东西比任何跟性有关的事都让我{i}难受得多{/i}。

lines.en: : But when two people that I’m close to hook up in a way I can understand and relate to and feel {i}good{/i} about...not telling me is like, robbing me of that happiness or whatever.
lines.zh: : 但当我亲近的两个人以一种我能理解、能共鸣、并且能让我{i}觉得好{/i}的方式搞在一起……不告诉我，就像是把那份快乐从我这儿抢走了之类的。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome27
: Like I said, I suck when it comes to explaining things like this. It would have been way easier if I could’ve just blackmailed you about it instead or something.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，我不擅长解释这种事。要是能拿这事敲诈你一下什么的，反而容易多了。

lines.en: : When it comes down to it, I’m happy for you two. What I’m upset about is not being included in something I thought I {i}would{/i} be included in.
lines.zh: : 说到底，我为你们俩高兴。我气的是，我本以为自己{i}会{/i}被包括在内的事，却没有我的份。

lines.en: : Like, I feel like {i}I’m{/i} making a bigger deal out of this development than either of you are and that’s like, totally weird for me.
lines.zh: : 就好比，我觉得{i}我{/i}比你们俩都更把这进展当回事，这对我来说……也太奇怪了。

lines.en: : I think the weirdest part of all is how you’re able to root for both Miku {i}and{/i} Noriko without feeling like you have to choose sides.
lines.zh: : 我觉得最奇怪的是，你居然能同时为 Miku {i}和{/i} Noriko 加油，而不觉得必须选边站。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome28

: Yeah...but as long as you’re able to keep things under wraps, which you’ve been pretty good at so far, I think everyone might be able to walk away when this is all said and done without getting hurt.
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过只要你还能把事情捂住——目前为止你做得还不错——我觉得等一切结束，大家也许都能全身而退，不受伤。

lines.en: : Fortunately, I don’t think that’s much of an issue with Miku as she seems to be entirely open to me being with...literally everyone that I want to be with.
lines.zh: : 幸好这对 Miku 来说不太成问题，她似乎对我跟……任何我想在一起的人在一起都完全开放。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome29
: Yeah, what’s up with that? I got that same vibe on the beach and it, like...totally threw me for a loop.
lines.zh: : 对啊，那是怎么回事？我在沙滩上也感觉到同样的氛围，那可真是……把我整懵了。

lines.en: : You don’t think she accidentally picked that up from me, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会觉得她是偶然从我这儿学去的吧？

lines.en: : Probably not, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 大概不是，Kirin。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome30
: Hey, how can you be so sure? For all we know, I might be a major role model for her on her way to sexual addiction.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你怎么能这么肯定？说不定我其实是她走向性瘾路上的重要榜样呢。

lines.en: : Probably because Miku is {i}actually{/i} okay with me seeing other people and you’re just pretending to be.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为 Miku {i}真的{/i}能接受我见别人，而你只是在装。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome31
: I’m...what?
lines.zh: : 我……什么？

lines.en: : Why would you say that? That’s not true. That’s definitely not true. Where did you get that idea?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么说？那不是真的。那绝对不是真的。你从哪儿得出这个念头的？

lines.en: : Well, let me ask you this-
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我问你——

lines.en: : If I asked you to abandon everyone and everything else to run away with me right now, would you?
lines.zh: : 如果我现在要你抛下其他所有人和所有事，跟我私奔，你愿意吗？

lines.en: : We could fuck a million times a day...and “watch the world burn” or whatever it was you said when we first started hanging out.
lines.zh: : 我们可以一天做一百万次……然后“看这世界烧成灰”什么的，就像我们刚混在一起那会儿你说的。

lines.en: : If I gave you the chance to have me all to yourself, would you take it?
lines.zh: : 如果我给你一个独占我的机会，你会接受吗？

lines.en: scene nightsky
: Yeah.
lines.zh: : 愿意。

lines.en: : We should do it.
lines.zh: : 我们该这么做。

lines.en: : We should leave everyone...and everything else behind.
lines.zh: : 我们该把其他所有人……还有所有事都抛在身后。

lines.en: : It was a hypothetical question, Kirin. I’m not actually asking you to do this with me. I just wanted to prove a point.
lines.zh: : 那是个假设性的问题，Kirin。我不是真的要你跟我一起做这件事。我只是想证明一个观点。

lines.en: scene kirinwalkhome32
: Why does it have to be hypothetical?
lines.zh: : 为什么非得是假设？

lines.en: : If we can make a world for ourselves amidst all of this shit...why don’t we just do it?
lines.zh: : 如果我们能在这一切狗屎当中给自己造出一个世界……那我们为什么不干脆就去做？

lines.en: : What’s stopping us?
lines.zh: : 有什么在拦着我们？

lines.en: : We probably care more about other people than we let ourselves believe.
lines.zh: : 我们大概比自己愿意承认的更在乎别人。

lines.en: : You and I are similar in that way. We don’t like admitting to things we think are weaknesses, but the fact we think of them as weaknesses at all is confusing.
lines.zh: : 你和我在这方面很像。我们都不喜欢承认自己觉得是弱点的东西，可我们居然会把它们当成弱点，这本身就挺让人困惑的。

lines.en: : Am I not enough for you?
lines.zh: : 我对你来说不够吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think you are.
lines.zh: : 我不认为你够。

lines.en: : Am {i}I{/i} enough for {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}对{i}你{/i}来说够吗？

lines.en: : Do you...
: Maybe want to hold hands on the way home?
lines.zh: : 要不要在回家的路上牵手？

lines.en: : Just because it would be, like...ironic. For {i}us{/i} to do that, I mean. Since we’re just not the type and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 就因为那会，那个……挺讽刺的。我是说对{i}我们{/i}而言。毕竟我们又不是那种人什么的。

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太想。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah! Me neither, obviously. That was just a joke anyway. As if {i}we{/i} would...
lines.zh: : 我……我也是！显然啊。刚才那本来就是开玩笑的。好像{i}我们{/i}真的会……

lines.en: : Ever do...
lines.zh: : 会去做……

lines.en: scene black
: Are you sure?...
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？……

lines.en: I’ve always been weak, so I let her get the better of me three times before the night comes to an end.
lines.zh: 我一向软弱，所以在夜晚结束之前，我让她赢了三次。

lines.en: The first is when I take her hand at the edge of the riverbank.
lines.zh: 第一次，是我在河岸边缘牵起她的手。

lines.en: The second is when she takes my arm beneath a crumbling overpass.
lines.zh: 第二次，是她在一座破败的天桥下挽住我的手臂。

lines.en: The third is when I take her lips just outside her parents’ home.
lines.zh: 第三次，是我夺走她的唇，就在她父母家门外。

lines.en: As I walk away, I recall a recent reflection.
lines.zh: 走开的时候，我想起了不久前的一段遐想。

lines.en: I recall bodies in windows and eyes without irises.
lines.zh: 我想起窗户里的躯体，和没有虹膜的眼睛。

lines.en: And I tell myself it matters not if those who peer through glass are blind at all.
lines.zh: 我告诉自己，那些隔着玻璃窥视的人是否真的失明，并不重要。

lines.en: What matters is what they think about the things they see.
lines.zh: 重要的是他们如何看待自己看见的东西。

lines.en: And what those thoughts could do to me.
lines.zh: 以及那些念头会对我造成什么。
